set-variable.name: rp-safety-stream
rp-safety-input-state
rp-cs-shield-body
rp-cs-analyze-body
rp-shield-result
rp-analyze-result
rp-safety-decision

return-response.set-body: @((string)context.Variables["rp-safety-decision"] == "block" ? "{\"error\":{\"code\":\"gateway_safety_blocked\",\"message\":\"The request was blocked by gateway content safety.\"}}" : (string)context.Variables["rp-safety-decision"] == "reject" ? "{\"error\":{\"code\":\"gateway_safety_rejected\",\"message\":\"The request could not be verified by gateway content safety.\"}}" : "{\"error\":{\"code\":\"gateway_safety_unavailable\",\"message\":\"Content safety could not be verified.\"}}")
